reading: The sketch lays out a festival landing page: a thin top rule becomes a boxed-free nav, three wavy lines become a giant 3-line headline, concentric squares become an inset artwork panel holding a spinning conic-gradient ring, a circle becomes a tilted yellow CTA button, three short wavy lines on the right become a 3-row schedule list, and a bottom-left wavy line becomes a small date/location line, all styled per the typed notes (dark navy page, cream Helvetica type).
